description: Create house.touch_updated_at(), the trigger function that maintains updated_at.
rationale: A DEFAULT only fires on INSERT, so updated_at is a lie without a trigger. One function serves every table because it names no column but the one it sets.

intents.name: touch_updated_at
intents.comment: BEFORE UPDATE trigger function: stamps NEW.updated_at with now(). Deliberately not SECURITY DEFINER -- it needs no privilege the writer does not already have.
intents.body: BEGIN NEW.updated_at := now(); RETURN NEW; END;
